Delivery is free on orders over $50. For smaller orders, a delivery fee is calculated and shown at checkout before you pay.

mainEntity.name: How fast will my order arrive?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most orders placed during store hours arrive the same day, often within a couple of hours. During busy times like weekends and holidays, delivery windows may run a little longer.

mainEntity.name: Do I need to show ID?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. The person receiving the order must be 21 or older and present a valid government-issued photo ID at handoff. If no one of age is available to accept the order, it returns to the store.

mainEntity.name: Can I return or exchange a product?

acceptedAnswer.text: Unopened products in their original condition can usually be exchanged in store. Give us a call at (512) 614-4949 and we'll make it right.

mainEntity.name: Can you special order something you don't carry?

acceptedAnswer.text: Absolutely. If a product is available from our distributors, we can usually have it in store within a few days. Call or email either location with what you're looking for.

mainEntity.name: Can I send an order as a gift?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes! Add delivery instructions at checkout and we'll bring the order to your recipient. The recipient must be 21 or older and show valid ID when accepting the delivery.
